messages:
sara: Quick sync—I'm drafting the launch gates for the new invoke API surface (schema + results shape + telemetry). proposing a minimal set of stability checks before GA. want quick 👍/concerns so I can lock scope.

kevin: what are you thinking for backward compatibility? we need rules for optional/required fields and versioning. semver?

lina: metrics we should capture: per-invoke latency p50/p95/p99, schema_violation_count, tool_error_count, sample_payloads (scrubbed). dashboards + alert thresholds.

sara: exactly. initial thought: schema_v1 immutable once GA; any breaking change requires v2. non-breaking fields can be added with "nullable" or optional. contract tests required in CI.

dario: canary policy idea: 5% traffic for 24h, fail if schema_violation_rate > 1% OR p95 latency regress > 10% vs baseline. auto rollback if fail.

sara: here's a small canary snippet for the rollout doc:```yaml
canary:
  percent: 5
  duration: 24h
  fail_conditions:
    - metric: schema_violation_rate
      threshold: 0.01
    - metric: p95_latency_relative
      threshold: 0.10
```

kevin: SDK impact: we'll need typed bindings for generated tool schemas and runtime checks. estimate 2 sprints (core SDK) + one for docs. also need sample apps.

lina: I'll own telemetry dashboards + runbooks. propose these alert thresholds: schema_violation_rate > 0.5% warning, >1% page. p95 latency increase >8% warning, >12% page.

dario: CI contract test idea: lightweight runner that loads tool schema + sample tool and runs a handful of calls asserting shape. sample curl:```bash
curl -X POST /_internal/contract-test -d '{"schema":"/specs/toolA.json","cases":[{"in":"...","expect":"shape"}]}'
```

sara: Prioritization ask: for GA we need: 1) stable schema v1 + docs, 2) CI contract tests passing on PRs, 3) telemetry dashboards + alerts, 4) canary rollout policy implemented, 5) rollback automation. anything missing?

kevin: add SDK migration guide and codegen for schema -> types. also add perf tests for kv cache interaction when tools are used heavily.

lina: add sampling policy for recorded payloads (masking rules + retention 30d). I'll draft sample scrubbing rules.

dario: agree. also want a small experiment flag for function chaining (opt-in) so we don't expose early complexity to GA customers.

sara: ok locking scope: GA = schema v1 + sync invoke results + structured output + telemetry + canary + CI contract tests + SDK minimal. chaining, streaming, extended tool orchestration -> named as v2. I'll update roadmap doc and post a changelog PR. pls confirm by EOD.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: noted. Created ticket RW-7812 for canary infra work and RW-7813 for contract-test runner. :white_check_mark:

kevin: +1

lina: +1 :thumbsup:

dario: +1

sara: thanks all — will update ROADMAP and ping again when PRs are up.
